summary: Consume nine-target maintenance release assets and conditional authorization.
details: The existing asset reader accepts the 4.2.1 maintenance seal, support records and canonical tag. Package names, versions, ZIP roots and metadata must agree with CCC01; published 4.2.0 predecessor custody remains bound through inventory and publication authorization.

A separate conditional authorization contract preserves required technical acceptance and maintainer-managed Portal delivery. The old 4.2.0 authorization and testing waivers cannot authorize 4.2.1. Focused structural tests claim no native qualification, signing, main promotion or publication.
